from.place: proof, finite-algebra calculation: spread the purely inseparable residual field factors and localize so that they are finite radicial covers

title: Spreading purely inseparable factors
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian integral domain with fraction field $K$, let $A'$ be a finite etale $A$-algebra [def-weil-etale-morphism] that is a domain with fraction field $K'$, and let $E$ be a finite $A'$-algebra that is a domain with fraction field $L$, where $L/K'$ is finite purely inseparable [def-pc-field-extension] [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. After replacing $A$ by a further principal localization and base-changing $A'$ and $E$, the induced morphism $\operatorname{Spec}(E)\to\operatorname{Spec}(A')$ is surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] and radicial [def-weil-radicial-morphism], hence a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism].
